title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode7 Remembering The Old Days

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh no. D-Does this mean we're lost...?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Calm down, Len.
But... What do we do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can use my phone to let Kanade and the others know...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay, I got a hold of them...
They said to wait and stay put.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness...
We should be fine now, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's find a place that's easy to find and wait for them there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Aren't you scared of being all alone like this...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<O-Okay...
That's amazing... I'm actually a little scared...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why are you so scared, Len...?
You're not actually alone right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I keep going back to when I arrived in SEKAI for the first time...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah... It was so big and empty...
And I was lost until Miku found me.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Just the thought of that still petrifies me a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me. When I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu, this amusement park's very crowded, so you need to promise not to stray too far from me.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thank you for bringing me here, Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Everything's so sparkly...!
And everyone's smiling like they're really having fun!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, look.
The churros from that shop are supposed to be very good. Shall we go try it out?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
There's quite a line...
Would you be okay with us waiting a little?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That's okay!
This park's so sparkly that I'm having fun just looking at everything!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're such a good girl, Mafuyu.
But you still need to promise to stay by my side.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What should we go on after we get our churros...? The merry-go-round's really cute, but the fish coaster also looks fun.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Phenny's supposed to go for walks sometimes around the park too.)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's Phenny! Oh, I wanna shake hands with him...!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Here's your churro, Mafuyu.
Is plain okay?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, plain's okay!
Also, Mommy, I just saw Phenny over there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Just a minute.
Your father's calling me. What could this be about?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh no... Phenny's about to leave... If I don't go now, I might not get to shake hands with him...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I have to stay close to Mommy...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Mafuyu. In a minute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you'll be done with work early?
That means I'll need to start preparing dinner soon.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But Phenny's right there, so maybe if I go for just a little bit...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I got to shake hands with Phenny...
Now I need to get back to where Mommy is!)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mommy was just right here...
Where'd she go?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Wh-What do I do...?
I'm lost... I have to find Mommy...

rows.Speaker: Female Passerby
rows.Line:
Oh, what's wrong?
Did you get separated from your mommy and daddy?

rows.Speaker: Female Passerby
rows.Line:
You seem lost...
Can you tell me your name?

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Wait, Mommy said that I'm not supposed to talk to any strangers...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Some strangers tried to talk to me... And everyone else is staring at me...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Was the merry-go-round always that big...? The horsies looked so much cuter before...)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(The park stopped being sparkly too...
What's going on...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I'm scared... I'm so scared...
Mommy... Where are you...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu!
Thank goodness! I looked all over for you...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I was worried sick about you.
But I'm so glad I found you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Mafuyu?
Are you hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
You being safe is all that matters.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: However, Mafuyu, can I ask you one question?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Why did you break our promise?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Didn't you say that you wouldn't leave my side? So why did you decide to run off like that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You disappearing like that absolutely terrified me, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was afraid that you'd become a “bad girl” that gives her mother grief...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, Mafuyu. The thought of you vanishing from right out under me made me so sad...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It made my heart sink... And made me so fearful...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Mommy...!
Please, don't cry... I... I...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to see you cry...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I'd feel so much better if I knew that you'd be a “good girl” who listens to what her mother says...

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
I promise to be a good girl...!
I promise to listen to what you say...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's okay.
I feel much better now that I know you're going to be a good girl for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's head home for the day.
I need to start preparing dinner so that your father can come home at any time.

rows.Speaker: Little Mafuyu
rows.Line:
M-Mommy...
That hurts... Please, don't pull...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My mom's hand felt so cold that time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, not just then...
Even now... She feels so cold...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <O-Oh no...! We have to help her...!>

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line:
There you are!
Thank goodness... Are you hurt?

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line: You must've been so scared, but you're safe now. Let's hold hands so you don't get lost again.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah. Her heart must've felt so cold when she was all alone...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Len, you know what that feels like...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I was like her too...
When I arrived in SEKAI, there was no one but me...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I tried looking for everyone, but I couldn't find any of them...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<But then, Miku found me...
And felt so warm when she took my hand.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because it felt like she was saying, “You're not alone”...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So I thought that little girl must've felt the same way.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I think I've felt the warmth he's talking about before...)
